device_name_title: Force Compute Device for Heavy Tasks
aitrans_context_title: Include Full Transcript Context in AI Translation
remove_dubb_silence_title: Trim Start/End Silence in Dubbed Segments
remove_dubb_all_silence_title: Strip All Silence in Dubbed Segments
show_more_settings_title: Show Advanced Settings on Main UI
llm_resegment_title: Use LLM for Resegmentation Instead of Correction
lang_notice: Set the software UI language. Requires a restart to take effect.
noise_model_notice: ZipEnhancer automatically selects the optimal device via audio.cpp; other models run on CPU only.
countdown_sec_notice: Pause duration (in seconds) for interactive review in single-video translation. Set to 0 to skip the editor window.
homedir_notice: Sets the output directory for standalone tools (e.g., batch transcription, subtitle dubbing, srt translation). Not for main video translation results. Defaults to the 'output' folder in the installation directory.
retry_nums_notice: Number of retry attempts for recoverable network or processing errors.
llm_chunk_size_notice: Number of subtitle lines sent per batch for LLM proofreading. Larger values provide better context and segmentation, but excessively large batches may exceed model context/output token limits. Default: 20 lines.
llm_ai_type_notice: AI provider used for LLM-based subtitle proofreading and correction.
dont_notify_notice: Suppress desktop notifications upon task completion or failure.
uvr_models_notice: Model used for separating vocal tracks from background audio.
noise_separate_nums_notice: Number of threads allocated for vocal separation and denoising. Higher values are faster but increase resource consumption.
batch_nums_notice: Number of videos to process concurrently in batch mode. Default is 0 (unlimited).
show_more_settings_notice: Most advanced parameters are hidden by default to keep the interface simple. Enable this to display all parameters on the main interface.
process_max_notice:
Maximum concurrent CPU tasks. Higher values increase speed but consume more RAM; should not exceed total CPU cores.
(Restart required to apply changes)
process_max_gpu_notice:
Maximum concurrent GPU tasks. Recommended setting is 1 unless you have high-capacity VRAM.
(Restart required to apply changes)
device_name_notice: Force heavy tasks to run on a designated device. Do not modify unless you understand the configuration requirements.
bit8_notice: Apply 8-bit quantization to Qwen3-TTS to reduce VRAM consumption.
crf_notice: Constant Rate Factor (CRF) controls compression quality. 0 = lossless (very large file size); 51 = worst quality (smallest file size).
preset_notice: Balances encoding speed and compression ratio (ultrafast, superfast, veryfast, faster, fast, medium, slow, slower, veryslow). Slower presets produce smaller files at equal quality.
video_codec_notice: Select libx264 or libx265. H.264 offers broader compatibility; H.265 provides higher compression efficiency and clarity.
out_video_ext_notice: Container format for the output video (mp4 or mkv).
fps_mode_notice: When slow-motion video processing is applied, Variable Frame Rate (VFR) yields smoother playback, whereas Constant Frame Rate (CFR) provides maximum compatibility.
force_lib_notice: Force FFmpeg to use software encoding? (Slower, but avoids hardware-specific encoding glitches. Hardware acceleration is preferred by default).
hw_decode_notice: Force CUDA decoding during the final video muxing step. Faster, but more prone to pipeline errors.
ffmpeg_cmd_notice: Custom FFmpeg parameters inserted before the output file argument (e.g., -bf 7 -b_ref_mode middle).
vad_type_notice: Select the Voice Activity Detection (VAD) engine.
threshold_notice: Minimum confidence threshold to detect speech. Audio exceeding this probability is treated as speech, while lower segments are treated as silence or noise. Lower values increase sensitivity but may misidentify background noise as voice.
no_speech_threshold_notice: Lowering this value helps suppress hallucinations, but may skip low-volume speech.
max_speech_duration_s_notice: Maximum allowed duration (in seconds) for a single speech segment. Segments exceeding this will be forcefully split.
min_speech_duration_ms_notice: Minimum speech duration (in milliseconds). Subtitle segments shorter than this threshold will attempt to merge with adjacent segments.
min_silence_duration_ms_notice: Minimum trailing silence (in milliseconds) required to trigger a segment split. Splits will only occur during silent intervals exceeding this duration.
max_speech_duration_s2_notice: Maximum speech segment duration (in seconds) for secondary recognition. Segments exceeding this will be split forcefully.
min_speech_duration_ms2_notice: Minimum speech duration (in milliseconds) for secondary recognition. Subtitle segments shorter than this threshold will attempt to merge with adjacent segments.
model_for_recogn2_notice: Model used for secondary speech recognition (restricted to faster-whisper pipeline).
speaker_type_notice:
Speaker diarization model. The built-in model supports Chinese and English.
Using Pyannote requires a Hugging Face Access Token and accepted user terms on huggingface.co.

Guide: https://pvt9.com/shuohuaren
hf_token_notice: Enter your Hugging Face Access Token. Required for Pyannote models. See tutorial: https://pvt9.com/shuohuaren
cuda_com_type_notice: Computation data type for Faster-Whisper: int8 (minimal resource usage, fastest, lower accuracy); float32 (high resource usage, slower, high accuracy); float16 (recommended for CUDA acceleration). 'default' automatically selects the best option.
beam_size_notice: Beam size for transcription accuracy (1–5). 1 uses the least VRAM; 5 provides highest accuracy at higher VRAM usage.
best_of_notice: Candidate sampling count (1–5). 1 uses the least VRAM; 5 provides better consistency at higher VRAM usage.
condition_on_previous_text_notice: Provides preceding text as context to Whisper. Improves accuracy and consistency, but increases VRAM consumption and may cause repetitive loops or hallucinations.
repetition_penalty_notice: Increase this value to reduce repetitive loops in generated text.
compression_ratio_threshold_notice: Decrease this threshold to suppress repetitive hallucinations.
hotwords_notice: Keywords or specific vocabulary expected in the audio to guide recognition accuracy. Separate multiple entries with English commas.
gemini_recogn_chunk_notice: Number of audio slices submitted per batch when using Gemini ASR. Larger values yield better context, but may increase request failure rates.
zh_hant_s_notice: Automatically convert recognized Traditional Chinese subtitles into Simplified Chinese.
del_end_punc_notice: Remove trailing punctuation marks from subtitle lines.
asr_wait_notice: Delay (in seconds) between cloud ASR requests to prevent rate limiting.
trans_thread_notice: Number of subtitle lines submitted per batch to traditional translation engines.
aitrans_thread_notice: Number of subtitle lines submitted per batch to AI translation engines.
aitrans_context_notice:
Attach the entire original transcript as reference for higher translation accuracy.
[Notice]
1. Requires an advanced model supporting long context windows.
2. Response times may increase significantly.
translation_wait_notice: Delay (in seconds) between translation requests to comply with API rate limits.
aitrans_temperature_notice: Temperature parameter for AI translation models. Default: 0.1.
dubbing_thread_notice: Number of concurrent TTS synthesis threads.
dubbing_wait_notice: Delay (in seconds) between dubbing requests to comply with API rate limits.
remove_dubb_silence_notice: Trim leading and trailing silence buffers from each dubbed clip to improve video-audio synchronization.
remove_dubb_all_silence_notice: Strip all silence buffers (including start, end, and internal pauses) from dubbed clips for tighter sync.
remove_dubb_silence_level_notice: Intensity of silence removal: 'default' (moderate), 'low' (preserves natural pauses), 'max' (aggressive silence stripping).
save_segment_audio_notice: Save individual TTS audio files generated for each subtitle line.
normal_text_notice: Apply text normalization (formatting numbers, abbreviations, and symbols) prior to TTS synthesis.
edgetts_max_concurrent_tasks_notice: Max concurrent tasks for EdgeTTS. Higher values are faster, but increase the risk of request throttling or disconnects.
edgetts_retry_nums_notice: Number of retry attempts upon EdgeTTS failure. Non-recoverable failures will not resolve with excessive retries and will slow down processing.
max_audio_speed_rate_notice: Maximum allowed audio acceleration multiplier. Default: 100.
max_video_pts_rate_notice: Maximum allowed video slow-motion multiplier. Default: 10 (maximum value: 10).
cjk_len_notice: Maximum characters per line for CJK subtitles before line-wrapping. Applies to translated subtitles or standalone transcription outputs.
other_len_notice: Maximum characters per line for non-CJK subtitles before line-wrapping. Applies to translated subtitles or standalone transcription outputs.
llm_resegment_notice: Use the LLM for sentence re-segmentation instead of simple error correction. Subtitles will be restructured and re-split based on semantic boundaries rather than just correcting typos.
